Span.description: One canonical, recursively nested unit of work in an agent trace.

agent_id.description: Source-recorded agent ID, unique within the logical case: an AGENT span's own agent, or the agent an LLM call belongs to. Never a name shared by parallel agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

attributes.description: Additional lossless source metadata not represented by a typed field.
attributes.title: Attributes

children.description: Direct child spans in deterministic source execution order.
children.title: Children

cost_usd.description: Source-reported span cost in US dollars, when available.
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

end_time.description: Timezone-aware source end time, when recorded.
end_time.title: End Time

error.description: Authoritative source error text or status; do not infer one from output text.
error.title: Error

id.description: Stable span identifier, unique within its containing trace.
id.title: Id

input.description: Raw recorded input. Omit when absent; explicit JSON null remains null.
input.title: Input

kind.description: Normalized span category represented by this source span.

llm_params.description: Top-level request parameters the source records, without the model, tools and prompt content; a parameter not listed was not recorded, not necessarily left at its default. Valid only for an LLM span.
llm_params.title: Llm Params

output.description: Raw recorded output. Omit when absent; explicit JSON null remains null.
output.title: Output

start_time.description: Timezone-aware source start time, when recorded.
start_time.title: Start Time

token_counts.description: Source-reported token counts for this span, when available.

tool_call.description: Call/result join metadata; valid only for a TOOL span.

tool_definitions.description: Tools listed for this agent or model call, in source order. Omitted when unknown; an empty list means the source listed no tools.
tool_definitions.title: Tool Definitions

tool_name.description: Observed tool name for a TOOL span; preserve the source value.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

Span.title: Span

TokenCounts.description:
Non-negative token counts as the source records them.

Each count is copied from a source count with the same meaning, or summed from
the source's buckets that together make it, never derived from other counts;
a count the source does not record is None.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the cache, across all TTLs.
cache_write_tokens.title: Cache Write Tokens

cache_writes_by_ttl.description: Input tokens written to the cache per TTL in seconds, as the response reports them; may cover only some of cache_write_tokens.
cache_writes_by_ttl.title: Cache Writes By Ttl

cached_input_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the cache.
cached_input_tokens.title: Cached Input Tokens

input_tokens.description: Uncached input tokens; excludes cache reads and cache writes.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

input_total.description: All input tokens as the source totals them: uncached input plus cache reads and cache writes.
input_total.title: Input Total

output_tokens.description: Generated output tokens, reasoning tokens included.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

source.description: Where the counts were read, such as nemo_relay (the provider's usage), openinference or langfuse_sdk.
source.title: Source

TokenCounts.title: TokenCounts

ToolCall.description: Source metadata that identifies and joins one tool invocation.

call_id.description: The source's tool-call identifier. Preserve repeated IDs so duplicate instrumentation remains observable.
call_id.title: Call Id

index.description: Zero-based tool-call execution order when the source records it.
index.title: Index

instrumentation_alias_of.description: Canonical tool name when the observed name is an instrumentation alias.
instrumentation_alias_of.title: Instrumentation Alias Of

prior_user_text.description: Nearest preceding user text, only when captured from the source.
prior_user_text.title: Prior User Text

result_count.description: Number of source results matched to this call; use zero when none exists.
result_count.title: Result Count

result_id.description: The source result's genuine reference to this call, when available.
result_id.title: Result Id

results.description: Source results matched to this call, in source order; its length equals result_count. Omit when the results were not recorded, as in traces written before schema version 2.
results.title: Results

returned_data.description: Whether the result returned usable data; omit when the source cannot say.
returned_data.title: Returned Data

ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolDefinition.description: One recorded tool-list entry, with understood fields normalized.

input_schema.description: Declared input JSON Schema, when recorded.

name.description: The function name, or null if it could not be read from the source entry.
name.title: Name

server.description: Explicit source scope such as an MCP server; never inferred from the name.
server.title: Server

ToolDefinition.title: ToolDefinition

ToolResult.description: One source result returned for a tool invocation.

attributes.description: Additional lossless result metadata not represented by a typed field.
attributes.title: Attributes

content.description: Raw recorded result content. Omit when absent; explicit JSON null remains null.
content.title: Content

is_error.description: Source-recorded error flag; null when the source did not record a usable flag.
is_error.title: Is Error

ToolResult.title: ToolResult

TraceAggregate.description: Source-reported or deterministically derived whole-trace measurements.

cost_usd.description: Whole-trace cost in US dollars, when available.
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

latency_ms.description: Whole-trace latency in milliseconds, when available.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

TraceAggregate.title: TraceAggregate

description:
Canonical representation of one complete end-to-end agent run.

Source loaders deterministically construct this model before any Compass
Signal runs. Provider-specific parsing or compatibility logic does not
belong downstream of this boundary.

aggregate.description: Whole-trace measurements; use an empty object when none are available.

attributes.description: Additional lossless trace-level source metadata; do not invent values.
attributes.title: Attributes

evaluator_results.description: Normalized evaluation signals keyed by adapter-assigned names.
evaluator_results.title: Evaluator Results

id.description: Stable trace identifier, unique within the loaded corpus.
id.title: Id

root_spans.description: Complete root span trees in deterministic source execution order.
root_spans.title: Root Spans

source_url.description: Loader-resolved link to the original trace or local source file.
source_url.title: Source Url

title: Trace
